tha-ap245:1.1: Naḷinakesariya.] Jātasarassa vemajjhe vasāmi jalakukkuṭo / ath' addasaṃ devadevaṃ gacchantam anilañjase. // //
tha-ap245:2.1: Tuṇḍena kesariṃ gayha vippasannena cetasā / Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Tissassa lokabandhuno. // //
tha-ap245:3.1: Dvenavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap245:4.1: Tesattatimhi kappamhi Satapatta-sanāmako / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap245:6.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Naḷinakesariyo thero i. g. a-ti.
